questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Nicaragua?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Nicaragua article.

questions.proof: Its capital and largest city is Managua.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Nicaragua?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Nicaragua on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Nicaragua article.

questions.proof: It borders, El Salvador, Honduras, and Costa Rica.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Nicaragua?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Nicaragua article.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “On 30 January _____, following the approval of a constitutional reform, the country became a diarchy with Daniel Ortega and his wife Rosario Murillo becoming co-presidents.”

hints.nudge: It is a year in the twenty-first century.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Nicaragua article.

questions.proof: On 30 January 2025, following the approval of a constitutional reform, the country became a diarchy with Daniel Ortega and his wife Rosario Murillo becoming co-presidents.
